code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-length divider lines mark the repeated cells.
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len(set(row[j] for row in grid)) == 1]
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1]
    sep = grid[rows[0]][0] if rows else grid[0][cols[0]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if rows and cols:
        r, c = rows[0], cols[0]
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if i == r or j == c: continue
                si = i if i < r else i-r-1
                sj = j if j < c else j-c-1
                out[i][j] = grid[si][sj]
    elif cols:
        # The middle compartment is the source; copy it into the outer compartments.
        c0, c1 = cols[0], cols[-1]
        width = c1-c0-1
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if j in cols: continue
                if j < c0: sj = c0+((j-c0) % width)
                elif j > c1: sj = c0+((j-c1-1) % width)
                else: continue
                out[i][j] = grid[i][sj]
    return out
'''
